svg.title: How the NVA's route reaches the spoke
svg.desc: vm-nva runs FRR as ASN 65010 and announces a /24 held by its dummy interface lab0 to both rs-hub instances (ASN 65515) over eBGP multihop, learning the hub's and spoke's /20s back. Because the spoke uses the hub's remote gateway, Route Server puts the /24 in vm-app's effective routes with vm-nva as next hop, so vm-app's traffic for it goes to vm-nva.
